name: Uqua: Ocean God Chantry
summary: Ceremonial halls dedicated to the Ocean God, now flooded and corrupted by Discord energy.
description: The Ocean God Chantry is a vast ceremonial hall filled with ancient carvings, ritual altars, and flowing water channels. Once a sacred place of oceanic worship, the Chantry has been corrupted by Discord energy leaking from deeper fractures. Water flows unnaturally, forming spirals and rising against gravity. Muramite forces attempt to seize the Chantry’s ritual power, while Ocean Cult guardians defend their sacred domain. Discord manifestations erupt from corrupted water, turning the Chantry into a volatile battleground of ritual magic and planar instability.
